## Discovery & Translational Science

* **[Big Pharma]** **In vitro age-dependence of factor XIa inhibitor asundexian** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42962699/)
  * Evaluated the FXIa inhibitor asundexian across neonatal, pediatric, and adult plasma samples.
  * Identified age-dependent variations in plasma coagulation parameters, providing pharmacological context for pediatric dose extrapolation.

* **MUC1 frameshift protein length dictates renal survival in ADTKD-MUC1** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.28.26365901)
  * Reconstructed mutant variable number tandem repeat (VNTR) alleles in 49 patients using Oxford Nanopore long-read sequencing.
  * Demonstrated that MUC1 frameshift protein (MUC1-fs) length predicts disease severity: median kidney failure-free survival was 43 years for MUC1-fs >780 amino acids versus 65 years for shorter variants (HR 1.19 per 100 amino acids, p = 0.015).

* **Mitochondrial haplogroup T links post-checkpoint lymphocyte stability to melanoma outcomes** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.30.26366523)
  * Identified peripheral lymphocyte stability (LS) following one cycle of immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) as an on-treatment predictor of overall survival in metastatic melanoma.
  * Unstable post-ICB lymphocyte counts (LS-U ≤0.8) correlated with inherited mitochondrial haplogroup T, pre-treatment CD8⁺ T-cell mitochondrial transcript elevation, increased apoptotic pathway induction, and reduced clonal persistence.

* **GLP-1 receptor agonism disrupts anticipatory postprandial insulin secretion** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.27.26366633)
  * Showed that healthy postprandial insulin secretion rate (ISR) naturally leads blood glucose profiles by 6 ± 1 minutes via a GLP-1 feedforward mechanism, a process disrupted in obesity and prediabetes.
  * Treatment with semaglutide restored total ISR but abolished the anticipatory temporal offset between insulin and glucose, leading to post-prandial glycemic undershoots.

* **Anoxic adaptation mechanisms in marine mammals highlight ACSL3 and FPN1 as ferroptosis shields** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.10.744012)
  * Transcriptomic and lipidomic profiling of elephant seal endothelial cells revealed resistance to hypoxia/reoxygenation-induced lipid peroxidation independent of classical hydroperoxide scavenging.
  * Identified constitutive high expression of ACSL3 (driving cytoprotective lipid droplet biogenesis) and acute induction of the iron exporter ferroportin-1 (FPN1) as non-redundant protective mechanisms against ischemia-reperfusion injury.

* **ANXA1 stem cell state predicts aggressive disease and poor survival in colorectal cancer** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.28.26366700)
  * Evaluated LGR5 and ANXA1 expression in 2,163 trial tumors, identifying an inverse relationship between homeostatic LGR5⁺ CBCs and regenerative ANXA1⁺ stem cells (RSCs).
  * ANXA1 dominance strongly correlated with CMS1 molecular subtype, BRAF-V600E mutations, mismatch repair deficiency, and shorter cancer-specific survival (p < 0.001).

* **Clonally expanded B cells drive fibrosis in chronic Chagas cardiomyopathy** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.28.26366745)
  * Integrated transcriptomics, spatial profiling, and BCR sequencing to discover circulating and cardiac-resident clonally expanded B cells in patients with chronic Chagas cardiomyopathy (CCC).
  * Infiltrating B cell populations co-localized specifically with areas of established myocardial fibrosis and were absent in non-Chagas dilated cardiomyopathy hearts.

* **PROTAC-DB 4.0 expands targeted protein degradation database** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42963943/)
  * Updated knowledgebase integrates expanded datasets covering diverse targeted protein degradation modalities.
  * Incorporates artificial intelligence-powered tools for compound knowledge discovery and degradation property prediction.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

* **Psilocybin pilot trial demonstrates reduction in anhedonia in treatment-resistant depression** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42962721/)
  * Conducted a randomized controlled pilot trial evaluating psilocybin paired with psychological support in patients with treatment-resistant depression.
  * Demonstrated exploratory efficacy in improving self-reported anhedonia measures post-treatment.

* **Feasibility trial protocol published for external trigeminal nerve stimulation in pediatric ADHD** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.30.26365900)
  * Released the prespecified statistical analysis plan for the eTNS4ADHD randomized pilot trial in children and adolescents aged 7–17 years.
  * The study compares 4 weeks of nightly active external trigeminal nerve stimulation against sham stimulation to evaluate trial feasibility, recruitment, compliance, and exploratory symptom outcomes.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

* **[Big Pharma]** **ESMO readout highlights promise and challenges for Merck and Moderna's mRNA cancer vaccine** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/biotech-charts-esmo-2026-winners-losers/873281/)
  * Presented detailed late-stage trial data at ESMO for intismeran autogene (an individualized neoantigen therapy) combined with Keytruda in adjuvant melanoma, confirming reduced risk of disease recurrence after surgery.
  * Despite meeting clinical expectations, market reaction remained cautious over uncertainties surrounding broader efficacy in non-melanoma solid tumors and the commercial complexity of personalized manufacturing processes.

* **Network meta-analysis questions early aspirin withdrawal prior to 90 days post-PCI** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.28.26366775)
  * Analyzed 16 randomized trials (58,068 patients) evaluating P2Y12 inhibitor monotherapy following dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) after percutaneous coronary intervention.
  * Ischemic risk modeling showed that the odds ratio for myocardial infarction compared to 12-month DAPT was 1.31 at 0 days, 1.17 at 30 days, and 1.09 at 90 days, indicating that withdrawing aspirin prior to 90 days carries an incremental ischemic penalty despite lower major bleeding rates.

## Regulatory & Approvals

* **[Biotech]** **FDA grants accelerated approval to Inovio's Voceryq for recurrent respiratory papillomatosis** [FDA Press Release](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-plasmid-dna-based-immunotherapy-adults-recurrent-respiratory-papillomatosis)
  * Granted accelerated approval to Voceryq (doruxapapogene ralaplasmid and lalikinogene sifuplasmid-gxfd) for adults with HPV-mediated recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP).
  * Marks the first FDA approval for a plasmid DNA-based immunotherapy; demonstrated efficacy in reducing the frequency of surgical interventions required to clear airway papillomas.

* **FDA advances Digital Health Technologies framework for trial endpoints** [FDA Announcement](http://www.fda.gov/science-research/science-and-research-special-topics/digital-health-technologies-drug-development-demonstration-projects)
  * Outlined ongoing FDA-funded demonstration projects under PDUFA VII commitments to establish wearable-derived digital endpoints for registrational drug trials.
  * Key projects include validating wearable-based stride velocity 95th centile (SV95C) with Massachusetts General Hospital as a secondary/exploratory clinical endpoint in Phase 2/3 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) trials.

* **FDA updates minocycline susceptibility breakpoints for Stenotrophomonas maltophilia** [FDA Updates](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/development-resources/fda-rationale-breakpoints-recognition-decision-minocycline-stenotrophomonas-maltophilia)
  * Formally recognized CLSI intermediate (2 μg/mL) and resistant (≥4 μg/mL) minimum inhibitory concentration breakpoints for oral and IV minocycline against *Stenotrophomonas maltophilia*.
  * Declined to recognize the CLSI susceptible breakpoint (≤1 μg/mL) based on available pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic and clinical outcome evaluations.

* **FDA approves updated safety labeling across menopausal hormone therapies** [FDA Safety Update](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/drug-safety-and-availability/menopausal-hormone-therapies-updated-prescribing-information)
  * Approved updated prescribing information across multiple systemic and topical menopausal hormone therapies.
  * Impacted therapies include Prometrium (progestogen), Divigel, Cenestin, Enjuvia, Minivelle, Vivelle, Vivelle-Dot (systemic estrogens), Estring (vaginal estrogen), and Bijuva (combination).

## Business & Strategy

* **[Big Pharma]** **AstraZeneca launches $1.5B annual cost-cutting initiative** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/10/30/astrazeneca-cost-cutting-sun-pharma-facility-problems/)
  * Initiated a three-year cost-efficiency program intended to reduce operational expenditures by $1.5 billion annually.
  * The resulting savings are slated for direct reinvestment into core corporate R&D programs.

* **[Biotech]** **Setara Biosciences launches with $90M to pursue Charcot-Marie-Tooth drugs** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/setara-actio-charcot-marie-tooth-ion-channel-drugs/873227/)
  * Formed by the former leadership team of Actio Biosciences following the $1.3 billion sale of Actio's KCNT1 epilepsy assets to Jazz Pharmaceuticals.
  * Launched with $90 million in financing to advance clinical-stage assets for Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2C and overactive bladder, alongside discovery programs in rare diseases, epilepsy, and migraine.

## Public Health & Policy

* **Flavored cigar ban trial indicates reduction in young adult dual usage** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42962866/)
  * Conducted a randomized clinical trial assessing the behavioral impact of restriction policies on young adults who dual-use cigarettes and cigars.
  * Demonstrated that removing flavored options significantly reduced overall product usage and nicotine exposure in this demographic.

* **European survey reveals sub-national disparities in self-rated health** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.20.26366006)
  * Applied multilevel analysis (S-MAIHDA) to 171,193 respondents across 24 European Union countries within the European Social Survey (2014–2023).
  * Showed that individual sociodemographic strata (sex, age, financial status) accounted for more than twice the variance in poor self-rated health compared to nation-level differences alone (variance partition coefficient 10.4% vs 0.9%).

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [Dr. Mitch Rice: ‘An Incredibly Common Food That Melts Clogged Arteries (Most Eat Them Wrong)’](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v-Z9q9Uw2z8) -- Physionic
        - Explores the physiological mechanisms behind artery damage and the cellular origins of arterial plaque formation.
        - Examines how the antioxidant lycopene inhibits lipid oxidation processes implicated in cardiovascular disease progression.
        - Evaluates the role of specific dietary fats in cardiovascular outcomes and vascular health.
        - Reviews clinical literature regarding cardiovascular disease outcomes, plaque reversal, and preventive nutritional interventions.
    - [Why Healthcare Needs More Physician Entrepreneurs | Dr. Alison Curfman](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cKN4k1TNp1U) -- Health2Tech
        - Explores how successful clinical innovations, such as a virtual pediatric program reducing hospitalizations by 35% and ED visits by 50%, can fail due to alignment issues with fee-for-service financial models.
        - Describes the structure of Imagine Pediatrics, a virtual-first value-based care model managing over 100,000 Medicaid-covered children by linking financial incentives to health outcomes.
        - Outlines the requirements for healthcare startups to build financial sustainability, including establishing minimum viable clinical evidence and navigating alternative payment models.
        - Discusses the integration of artificial intelligence in healthcare delivery, highlighting safety risks, regulatory needs, and the necessity of clinical oversight.
        - Addresses physician burnout and career expansion through Startup Physicians, helping doctors transition into startup founders, advisors, and fractional chief medical officers.
- Pure Science
    - [What happens if I lower this weight into the water?](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/zEmabFZvdqA) -- Veritasium
        - Poses a physics problem analyzing force interactions when a suspended weight is submerged into a container of water resting on a scale.
        - Asks whether the scale reading will increase, decrease, or remain the same upon lowering the weight into the fluid.
        - Highlights principles of fluid displacement, buoyancy, and third-law reaction forces acting on the weighing scale.
    - [How Do Fungi Keep the Planet Healthy? | PODCAST: The Joy of Why](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zfVe1-c51Ws) -- Quanta Magazine
        - Details how mycorrhizal fungal networks form symbiotic nutrient-trading partnerships with 80% of plant species, a relationship that evolved over 450 million years ago.
        - Highlights that underground fungal networks sequester approximately 13 billion tons of atmospheric carbon dioxide annually, equivalent to roughly one-third of global fossil-fuel emissions.
        - Applies economic principles and game theory to explain how brainless, decentralized fungi make strategic trading choices, allocating resources to plants offering higher nutrient returns.
        - Describes experimental techniques—including fluorescent quantum dots and automated imaging robots—used to track nutrient movement through fungal networks.
        - Outlines global research efforts to map, understand, and protect underground soil biodiversity and non-neural biological decision-making.
- Tech & Engineering
    - [Waymo vs Tesla](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2hx9r7JE6mg) -- Wendover Productions
        - Compares the technical methodologies and commercial deployment strategies of autonomous driving companies Waymo and Tesla.
        - Evaluates architectural differences between full-stack sensor configurations (incorporating LiDAR, radar, and cameras) and vision-only camera systems.
        - Analyzes the operational models, safety profiles, regulatory hurdles, and scalability of robotaxis versus consumer-facing driver-assist systems.
